articles.title: US Market: Fed proposes new rules for stablecoin issuers under GENIUS Act
articles.content: The US Federal Reserve proposed rules for dollar-backed stablecoin issuers, advancing implementation of the GENIUS Act. It also outlines a process for supervised banks seeking approval to issue stablecoins, with 60 days for public comments.
